## Closed as a duplicate of objectui#10657 — one family, folded into its closure card

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015) · `session_01CRZSc7dU8oDStbTbSwhuZe` · 2026-09-25T20:30Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch. Read: this card, objectui#10657, and objectui `origin/main`.

The filer reads this as a different gap from objectui#10657, and the mechanism does differ: here the type is not known yet, while there a producer never sets the flag. The family is the same, though. A `password` / `secret` value reaches the viewer on a client path the masked-field guards should close. The current gate folds same-family findings into one closure card with one enumeration pin (objectstack-ai/objectstack#20110). objectui#10657 is that card. It is not in flight, so it can take the fold, and objectui#10583 itself, which is in flight, was not touched.

objectui#10657 now carries this row: the first paint before the schema settles, and the failed schema read. It keeps the measurement, the fail-closed direction and the pins, at `priority:p3` · `security`.
